observations.claim: Round 3 achieved a major breakthrough under H-005: 3/5 generated candidates beat Frozen_C (-0.10890), with candidate_3 reaching dev4=-0.15762 (-4.87pp) and sh6=10.3051 (-5.63% vs C, exact s001/s1=1.00000), and candidate_2 reaching dev4=-0.15461 and sh6=10.6080.
